context: A grandma teaches her young granddaughter an old family recipe
purpose: Teach: 牛乳/サラダ/キッチン/チョコ/食っ/栽培/分解/望ん

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ひな、今日はおばあちゃんのキッチンで、昔から伝わる家庭料理を教えてあげるね。
lines.en: Hina, today in grandma's kitchen, I'll teach you a home recipe passed down from long ago.
lines.style: Warm and inviting, slow grandmother pace, drawing the child in gently

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: わあ、楽しみ!お母さんがね、ずっと前からおばあちゃんの味、食べたがってたんだよ。
lines.en: Wow, I'm excited! You know, mom has been wanting to eat grandma's flavor for a long time.
lines.style: Bright childlike enthusiasm, slightly bouncy and eager throughout

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: まずはね、庭で家庭栽培してるじゃがいもと、冷たい牛乳を使うのよ。
lines.en: First, we use the potatoes from my home garden, and some cold milk.
lines.style: Gentle instructional tone, proud of homegrown ingredients, calm pace

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、横にあるサラダも一緒に作るの?チョコケーキも食べたいな!
lines.en: Grandma, are we making the salad next to it too? I want to eat chocolate cake as well!
lines.style: Curious and a little greedy, child voice trailing into giggles softly

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、欲張りさんだね。材料を一つずつ分解して並べると、順番がよく分かるのよ。
lines.en: Hehe, what a greedy little one. If you break the ingredients down one by one and lay them out, the order becomes clear.
lines.style: Affectionate teasing laugh, then shifting to wise teaching tone gently

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、昔『うまい、うまい』って食ってたんでしょ?おばあちゃんが言ってたよ。
lines.en: Grandpa used to eat it saying 'delicious, delicious,' right? You told me before.
lines.style: Thoughtful child curiosity quoting grandpa's rough speech playfully, slightly reflective

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そうよ、大好物だったの。おじいちゃんも『また食べたい』って望んでたわ。
lines.en: Yes, it was his favorite. Grandpa kept wishing he could eat it again.
lines.style: Tender nostalgic warmth, voice softening with memory of late husband

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: じゃあ、ひなも覚えて、いつか自分のキッチンで作ってあげるね!
lines.en: Then I'll learn it too, and one day I'll make it in my own kitchen!
lines.style: Bright determined child promise, voice rising with happy resolve
